objects: CREATE TABLE attributions (fill_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES fills(fill_id), decision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cycles(decision_id), data TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE configurations (generation INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, config_hash TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE cycles (decision_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, generation INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES configurations(generation), action_key TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES intents(action_key), data TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE fills (fill_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, action_key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL REFERENCES intents(action_key), data TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE instances (instance_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, data TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE intents (action_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, data TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE journal (seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, event_key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, request_hash TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, previous_hash TEXT NOT NULL, chain_hash TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE metadata (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), context TEXT NOT NULL, blocked TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE postings (seq INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal(seq), idx INTEGER NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(seq,idx))
CREATE TABLE projection (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), version INTEGER NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_attributions_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON attributions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable modular history'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_attributions_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON attributions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable modular history'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_configurations_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON configurations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable modular history'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_configurations_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON configurations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable modular history'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_fills_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON fills BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable paper history'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_fills_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON fills BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable paper history'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_journal_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON journal BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable paper history'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_journal_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON journal BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable paper history'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_postings_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON postings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable paper history'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_postings_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON postings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable paper history'); END
